Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior Staff Engineer to lead backend engineering efforts specifically focused on identity and access management (IAM) for our next-generation AI cloud platform.
Coupang is building a platform designed to power AI workloads at scale. As part of this multi-year initiative, the Identity team is responsible for managing user and machine identities, authentication, authorization, and secure service-to-service communication across the platform.
This role will drive the development of foundational identity services that enable secure, scalable cloud infrastructure, handling hundreds of thousands of authentication events daily with rapidly growing scale.
You will have the opportunity to :
Build and scale identity and authentication systems for a next-generation AI platform
Work on cutting-edge IAM challenges including OAuth2, OIDC, service-to-service authentication, and machine identity
Operate and scale systems handling 500K+ authentication requests daily
Collaborate across global teams in India, US, and other regions

Lead and grow a high-performing backend engineering team focused on identity and access management
Drive development of core IAM capabilities including authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management
Design and build scalable systems for user identity and machine identity management within a cloud environment
Work on modern authentication protocols such as OAuth2, OIDC, and SAML, and implement secure service-to-service authentication
Build and evolve authorization frameworks leveraging RBAC/ABAC models and policy engines (e.g., OPA)
Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable infrastructure for AI workloads
Drive technical design, execution planning, and delivery of complex distributed systems
Ensure reliability, scalability, and security of identity systems as the platform scales rapidly
Mentor engineers and foster a strong engineering culture focused on ownership and excellence

13 - 17 years of backend software engineering experience.
Strong experience in backend development using Java or Python with REST API design
Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization technologies (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML)
Solid understanding of identity systems including user identity and machine/workload identity
Experience with service-to-service authentication and distributed system security
Strong problem-solving and execution skills with ability to break down complex systems
Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building IAM systems in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Familiarity with PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and secure identity frameworks
Experience with authorization frameworks (RBAC, ABAC, OPA)
Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures
Experience working on large-scale distributed systems handling high request volumes
Background in platform engineering or infrastructure teams

Hybrid / Onsite / Remote working

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
로켓그로스의 핵심 가치와 서비스 이해를 바탕으로, 잠재 및 기존 판매자(셀러) 대상의 브랜드 인지도를 제고하고 참여를 유도하는 온·오프라인 마케팅 캠페인을 기획 및 실행하는 역할입니다. 판매자들이 모이는 온·오프라인 접점(커뮤니티, 포럼, 박람회, 디지털 포스트 등)을 적극적으로 발굴하고, 데이터 기반의 인사이트를 토대로 타겟팅된 커뮤니케이션 및 콘텐츠 마케팅을 신속하게 전개하게 됩니다. 단순한 캠페인 운영을 넘어 새로운 판매자 접점과 마케팅 기회를 발굴하고 검증하며, 성과 분석을 바탕으로 빠르게 실행과 개선을 반복하여 비즈니스 성장에 기여합니다.

jobs.description: We're building the next generation of AWS enterprise contract automation, making deal creation autonomous, intelligent, and self-service. You'll define the AI-powered platform behind billions of dollars in AWS private pricing agreements, serving customers from mid-market companies to the world's largest enterprises. This is the foundation for how customers commit to AWS and how AWS delivers on those commitments accurately and at scale. As Principal Product Manager - Technical External Services, you'll define the future of our contract automation platform including AI-powered systems that can draft, simulate, negotiate, ingest, and validate contracts without manual intervention. You'll define how AWS represents commercial intent as structured data, establish governed libraries of reusable contract terms and negotiation policies, architect the guardrails that make autonomous contract generation safe, and build the self-service experiences that let customers of different size configure and commit to agreements through digital channels. Your work directly determines how quickly AWS can close enterprise deals, whether contracts produce accurate billing from day one, and whether customers can self-serve commitments without sales engagement. In this role, you'll define product strategy that spans multiple years, driving initiatives that fundamentally change how enterprise agreements flow through AWS. You'll architect complex data models for ambiguous commercial domains, design how AI agents generate and negotiate contracts within defined boundaries, and build simulation and decision-support capabilities that help deal teams model revenue impact and make better commercial decisions before committing. You'll establish the mechanisms — operating cadences, metrics, escalation paths — that make contract automation delivery repeatable across multiple organizations. You'll conduct direct research with deal teams, enterprise customers, and commercial operations teams to understand where the contracting process creates friction, translating those insights into product requirements. You'll collaborate with engineering teams across AWS's billing, agreements, and commercial operations organizations, as well as applied science teams building the AI models that power drafting and negotiation. You'll partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align contract automation with go-to-market strategy for enterprise and mid-market segments. You'll mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar across the organization. This role requires deep understanding of how AI agent systems work and how to constrain them safely, combined with the cross-organizational influence to bring diverse stakeholders together around a common vision. If you're passionate about building systems that fundamentally change how enterprises transact in the cloud, and excited about defining how AI transforms the most complex commercial negotiations at scale, this role offers the chance to create AWS's contract automation platform from the ground up — serving everyone from deal negotiators managing billion-dollar relationships to mid-market customers self-serving their first private pricing agreement. Key job responsibilities - Define product strategy spanning multiple years, driving contract automation initiatives from concept through production - Architect the machine-readable data model that represents AWS's commercial agreements as structured, actionable data, including reusable contract terms and policy rules - Design AI-powered contract generation and negotiation experiences with appropriate guardrails and escalation mechanisms - Define self-service contract experiences for enterprise and mid-market customers - Build simulation and data-driven decision-support capabilities for deal teams - Establish mechanisms that make cross-organizational delivery repeatable - Conduct direct research with deal teams and enterprise customers to validate product direction - Partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align with go-to-market strategy - Mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar

jobs.description: Job Location MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR Job Description Purdue University R&D Engineer Co-op- Purdue Students Graduating in 2028/2029 ONLY Your first step towards an amazing career in Research and Development (R&D) at Procter and Gamble (P&G) starts with applying to this co-op. Within an R&D co-op, you’ll be actively involved in creating, reimagining and launching new innovations which improve our consumers lives… all around the world. The duration of our co-ops range from 12-24 weeks within the fiscal year located on-site at our Mason, OH or Cincinnati, OH sites. We are looking for a co-op starting January/February 2027. As a co-op, you'll receive a co-op allowance. At P&G, Intern/Co-Op sessions are considered temporary employment, with a predicted ending point. No full-time employment commitments are made. As a company, P&G believes that ‘innovation is our lifeblood’. As such, we invest to ensure that our products best serve the current and future needs of our more than 5 billion consumers worldwide across our 65 iconic, trusted brands. From Day 1, you’ll be equipped with cutting edge innovation tools, you’ll be encouraged to dive into the innovation process, and you’ll be tasked to advance real needs for our business. To enable your success, you’ll collaborate with talented technologists and mentors to strengthen your skillsets and develop new areas of mastery. The environments you’ll work in are creative workspaces where new ideas flourish and where your technical mastery is recognized and rewarded. Ultimately, our investment in you is equally an investment in the development of our future R&D talent and in advancing our lofty innovation goals. What will I do? Our Associate Scientist co-op’s are constantly learning, growing in service of improving how our products perform. In this role, you will find new ways to innovate, develop and manufacture consumer products. Since we’re a highly collaborative company, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest technical and commercial partners. We strive to match your skills, qualifications, and interests with a role that works best for you and have a number of areas in R&D where you could work as a co-op, including: Products Research: Deeply understand our consumers and their needs in order to inform product design parameters for new or improved products. Analytical & Measurement Science: Creates & develops ways to measure and characterize our products translating the consumer use experience to product specifications, ensuring superior and consistent functionality throughout the product lifecycle. Product Design & Development : Translates the consumer’s needs into the design and technical specifications of delightful grooming products which can be manufactured at scale. Product Formulation & Design : Translates the consumer’s needs into the development of delightful finished-products which use the best available technologies/chemicals/materials. Packaging Development: Creates and improves packages that delight consumers and retailers. Packaging technologists lead the development of packages of superior function and premium design. In addition to ensuring the product functions well once the consumer has brought it home, we place a premium in ensuring that our packages are responsibly developed with sustainability in mind. Blades & Metals Process Innovation: Deliver groundbreaking blade edge innovation through mastery of process, product, and equipment. Process Development & Pilot Plant Operations: Translates ideas, concepts, and technologies into the design and scale-up of commercially feasible, state of the art, chemical and mechanical manufacturing processes. Material Development: Start by developing 'new to the world' raw material technologies so we can meet our customer's needs with the highest quality, best performing materials. Modeling and Simulation (M&S): M&S development is a powerful capability which increasingly underpins the work across all our R&D functions. Our M&S experts are developing new to the world mathematical models which speed the pace and impact of our innovations. Data Science: Here, we would want you to communicate complex data or algorithms into simple conclusions that will empower others to drive action based on the insights you derive. As a Data Scientist, you will transform the business to enable better decision-making through the use of advanced analytics. Job Qualifications We are looking for Bachelor's/Master's students who are majoring in engineering degrees graduating in 2028 or 2029. We offer a wide range of roles for Chemical, Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering. Increasingly, we have roles designed for Data Science/Analytics. Have strong communication skills. Have both critical thinking and active listening. Has the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment. Candidates attending Purdue University must be able to work from Cincinnati/Mason, OH without relocation assistance. What we offer: Responsibilities as of Day 1 – you will feel the ownership of your project from the beginning, and you will be given specific projects and responsibilities. Continuous mentorship – you will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager. Work and be part of a dynamic and encouraging environment - working over a diverse array of interesting problems. Promote agility and work/life balance for employees, we value every individual and support initiatives. Experience true support for work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being. jobs.description: The Business, Industrial, and Scientific Supplies (BISS) vision is to make Amazon the most trusted destination for business supplies. BISS offers a wide variety of B2B relevant selection and is a major engine of growth for Amazon. This Sr. Program Manager role within the BISS team will be responsible for leading strategic initiatives for BISS selection that will help grow the BISS business and improve the customer experience in both the Amazon Business store and Amazon.com store. You have a strong level of intellectual curiosity, excellent organizational skills, a high degree of ownership and integrity, and a high attention to detail. You are an independent self-starter who thrives in connecting people and ideas and have a strong entrepreneurial drive. You excel at communication and are comfortable playing a lead role in a highly visible organization. Key job responsibilities • Think Big and own the vision for building a strategy that enables customers to discover and access the best selection for their business and professional needs on Amazon. • Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for BISS selection growth. • Be responsible for end-to-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review mechanisms, and cross-functional collaboration. • Break down ambiguous problems into clear use cases and solution workflows for Product, Technology, and Category teams. • Coordinate with BISS stakeholders (Product Managers, Vendor Managers, Business Development Managers) and external teams (Amazon Business Flywheel Inputs, Amazon Business Sales, Retail Business Services, Selection) to drive shared goals and deliverables. • Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority toward common goals. • Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them proactively. • Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep Dives). • Be responsible for end-to-end program management with multiple parallel workstreams and tasks. This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple cross-functional teams in re-imagining and improving the experience for BISS customers. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks. You will be data-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate.
